definitions.explanation: Making fun of oneself or putting oneself down, often for humorous effect. Can also refer to a broader tendency toward self-punishment or self-criticism.

examples.japanese: {自虐|じぎゃく}⟦ネタ→ネタ：06309_neta⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: To get laughs with self-deprecating humor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自虐|じぎゃく}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
{自虐|じぎゃく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ほどほど→ほどほど：05312_hodohodo⟧にしない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなる⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you don't keep the self-deprecation in check, you'll actually lose confidence.

notes:
A compound of {自|じ} (self) and {虐|ぎゃく} (abuse/torment). In modern usage, most commonly refers to self-deprecating humor rather than literal self-harm.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自虐|じぎゃく}⟦ネタ→ネタ：06309_neta⟧: self-deprecating joke/material
- {自虐|じぎゃく}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: self-deprecating, self-mocking
- {自虐|じぎゃく}{風|ふう}: self-deprecating style
- {自虐|じぎゃく}{史観|しかん}: masochistic view of history (political term)

USAGE:
In modern colloquial Japanese, {自虐|じぎゃく} most often refers to self-deprecating humor. {自虐|じぎゃく}⟦ネタ→ネタ：06309_neta⟧ is extremely common in Japanese comedy — comedians and everyday people alike use it to get laughs by making fun of their own appearance, habits, or circumstances.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {自虐|じぎゃく}: self-deprecation (often humorous)
- ⟦{自慢|じまん}→自慢：03278_jiman⟧: boasting, bragging (opposite tendency)
- ⟦{謙遜|けんそん}→謙遜：04142_kenson⟧: modesty, humility (polite rather than humorous)
